title: Copolymerization preparation of cationic cyclodextrin chiral stationary phases for drug enantioseparation in chromatography
protocol: Fit a 100-ml double-necked round-bottomed flask with a Teflon-coated magnetic stir bar and a Liebig condenser.
Attach a rubber septum to the condenser inlet for dry N2 and an outlet towards a bubbler containing paraffin oil.
Weigh out 6A-toluenesulfonyl-β-CD B 12.91 g into the flask.
Add 20 ml DMF into the flask.
Switch on the magnetic stirrer and heater.
Inject 1-vinylimidazole 3 ml into the flask through a plastic syringe.
Allow the reaction to proceed at 90°C for 48 h under reflux.
Cool down to room temperature.
Precipitate the product in acetone (200 ml).
Collect the precipitate by filtration.
Wash the raw product with acetone.
Dissolve the solid into water/methanol (200 ml/50 ml).
Heat towards 50°C to afford a clear solution if necessary.
Fill a column (I.D. 30 × 250 mm) with Amberlite IRA-900 ion-exchange resin and wash it with MilliQ water till the effluent pH is neutral.
Transfer the solution from step into the column and let it hold for 1 h.
Collect the effluent drop by drop after holding in the column.
Flush the column with equal volume MilliQ water and collect the effluent.
Distill off water on a rotary evaporator to yield C as a light yellow solid (9.7 g, 78% yield).
Fit a 250-ml double-necked round-bottomed flask with a Teflon-coated magnetic stir bar and a rubber septum.
Attach a Liebig condenser to the flask with a rubber septum.
Connect the condenser inlet to dry N2 and direct the outlet towards a bubbler containing paraffin oil.
Weigh out 2.15 g of compound C into the flask.
Add 20 ml of dried pyridine into the flask.
Switch on the magnetic stirrer and heater.
Inject phenyl isocyanate dropwise using a plastic syringe in a fumehood.
Add phenyl isocyanate drop by drop with pressure equalizing funnel.
Allow the reaction to proceed at 85 °C for 20 h.
Set up the vacuum distillation pipeline.
Distill off pyridine under reduced pressure at 85 °C.
Dissolve the residue with chloroform 15 ml.
Add the solution into silica column.
Flush the impurities with n-hexane/ethyl acetate (70:30 v:v).
Flush the product out of the column with MeOH.
Remove the solvent on rotary evaporator to yield D as a dark yellow solid (6.2 g, 66% yield).
Dry spherical silica gel particles (5 μm, 5g) in vacuum (10 mm Hg) at 150 °C for 24 h.
Cool down to room temperature.
Fit a 250-ml double-necked, round-bottomed flask with a Teflon-coated magnetic stir bar and a Liebig condenser.
Attach a rubber septum to the condenser with an inlet for dry N2 and an outlet towards a bubbler containing paraffin oil.
Add 100 ml of dry toluene into the flask.
Switch on the magnetic stirrer and heater.
Inject 3-methacryloxypropyltrimethoxysilane (2.3 ml) into the flask.
Add dried silica gel from step 22 into the flask.
Allow the reaction to stand at 90 °C for 18 hours.
Collect the product by filtration through a 0.45 μm pore size membrane.
Wash the collected product with MeOH in a Soxhlet apparatus overnight.
Dry the product overnight in an oven at 60°C under vacuum.
Dissolve compound D (0.7 g) in chloroform (30 ml).
Filter the solution through a 0.45 μm pore size membrane.
Transfer the filtrate and drop onto vinylized silica gel E (1.4 g) evenly with a glass syringe.
Dry the colloid-like mixture in vacuum (10 mm Hg) at 25 °C.
Fit a 100-ml double-necked, round-bottomed flask with two rubber septums.
Add the solid from the dried mixture into the flask.
Add AIBN (3 mg) into the flask.
Inject anhydrous toluene (20 ml) and 2,3-dimethyl-1,3-butadiene (2.6 ml) into the flask.
Freeze the mixture in liquid N2 in a Dewar dish.
Degas the reaction system in vacuum (10 mm Hg) for 0.5 h.
Take the flask out of the Dewar dish and thaw at room temperature.
Repeat steps 36 and 37 for three times.
Fit the flask with a Liebig condenser.
Fit the condenser with a rubber septum connected to dry N2 inlet and an outlet towards a bubbler containing paraffin oil.
Switch on the magnetic stirrer and heater.
Incubate the reaction mixture at 60 °C for 18 hours.
Cool down the reaction mixture.
Collect the product by filtration through a 0.45 μm pore size membrane.
Wrap the filter cake with filter paper.
Extract the solid in a Soxhlet extractor overnight.
Stop heating and collect the silica from the Soxhlet extractor.
Dry the product in an oven at 60 °C for 24 hours.
Pack IMPCSP into an empty stainless steel column with MeOH at 8,000 psi for 30 minutes.
